title: Global finite length for a fraction-field submodule
statement: Let R be a domain with fraction field K, and let M be an R-submodule of K^{\oplus r} for a nonnegative integer r. If R is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], then for every nonzero x in R the R-module M/xM has finite length [def-weil-pbc-module-length].
